title: ACID Support for Compute eXpress Link Memory Transactions
problem: Data integrity and ACID guarantee challenges arise when executing transactions over CXL disaggregated memory. Existing processor microarchitectures lack native support for transactional semantics across CXL-connected remote memory.
motivation: CXL enables dynamic memory resizing, heterogeneous memory types, and cross-processor data sharing, requiring robust ACID transaction support to maintain data integrity in high-performance and datacenter computing.
method: TCXL implements ACID transactions as a software library with a deployable backend controller (embedded in CXL controller, as standalone device, or on-host). It supports durable persistent memory transactions and volatile in-memory transactions with flexible pooling, and integrates with processor Hardware Transactional Memory for hybrid execution.
key_novelty: First ACID transaction support for CXL disaggregated memory requiring no changes to existing processor microarchitectures.
contributions: TCXL framework providing ACID transactions for CXL-based disaggregated memory without processor microarchitecture modifications
Support for both persistent durable and volatile in-memory transactions with flexible single/multi-processor pooling
Integration with processor Hardware Transactional Memory for hybrid on-processor and over-CXL transaction execution
Software library with flexible deployment options across CXL controller, standalone device, or host implementations

metrics.speedup: outperforms other approaches (specific values not provided in abstract)

limitations: Evaluation limited to CXL simulator and micro-benchmarks; real hardware performance validation not discussed.
primary_theme: ACID transaction support for CXL disaggregated memory
